property_summary: For any call to migrateTo after some deposits, the call must revert if msg.sender is not the creator; the buggy version allows non-creator calls to succeed, breaking creator-only migration.
change_summary: Replace 'require(creator == msg.sender)' with 'require(creator != msg.sender)' so the require condition fails for the creator but passes for others, altering who can call migrateTo successfully.
